$description: How tk slots whose web form has no direct native equivalent reach other platforms. tools/tokens-portable.mjs fails when a slot's source uses a web-only form (currentColor, url(), viewport or container units, env(), or a value that changes inside @media) and the slot is not listed here. kind: fluid, inherit, responsive or web-only. No native kit exists yet (docs/11-tokens-and-contracts.md); these are the mappings one will follow.

size-display.web: clamp from size-3xl at a 360px viewport up to size-4xl at 960px
size-display.ios: Dynamic Type: size-3xl in compact width, size-4xl in regular
size-display.android: WindowSizeClass: size-3xl at compact, size-4xl at medium and up

size-title.web: clamp from size-2xl at 360px up to size-3xl at 960px
size-title.ios: Dynamic Type: size-2xl compact, size-3xl regular
size-title.android: size-2xl at compact, size-3xl at medium and up

size-heading.web: clamp from size-xl at 360px up to size-2xl at 960px
size-heading.ios: Dynamic Type: size-xl compact, size-2xl regular
size-heading.android: size-xl at compact, size-2xl at medium and up

link-text.web: currentColor where the pack picks no link colour, else the pack's colour

link-hover.web: as link-text; hover is a pointer state
link-hover.ios: no hover on touch; the pressed state uses link-text

texture-signature.why: an SVG data URL tiled behind a surface; decoration only, never information. A native kit that wants it ships the same SVG as an image asset.

gutter.ios: space-4 in compact width, space-5 in regular
gutter.android: space-4 at compact, space-5 at expanded
